banner.title: THE UA SPELL TABLE LEDGER - the R342 PDF-ledger repair: the 6th-level column reads, the drifted cells re-seat, the fragment holes resolve, and the illusionist UA-new censuses pin
banner.provenance: The R784 handoff pointed here: the uaspelltables2.h print holes stayed pending the PDF. The archive.org full-text OCR of the continued table (pp. 30-31) reads the 6th-9th columns; the readable cells cross-check against the UA-new description rosters (R361-R368) and the R80 registry. The repaired rosters: 6th = 17, 7th = 16, 8th = 10, 9th = 8. The row-number column contradicts the alphabetical order and stays unpinned; Glassteel and Power Word Kill stay open; the "Whip" doubt strikes (uam2WhipName); the illusionist 3rd-6th columns resolve on the UA-new side only. The R342/R361/R362 regtest seams re-point at the repaired rosters.
